payload.title: Rewrite 'Read this before the board' for general readers, in four or six cards
payload.description: Author's direction 2026-09-23: the panel shown on every page ('Read this before the board': five items defined in HONESTY in biased_decisions/leaderboard.py, rendered in site/src/layouts/Base.astro) is too dry to read, even for its creator. Rewrite it to be accessible, engaging and informative for a general reader: plain words, concrete examples from our own results, a better title. Use four or six cards (not five) so the grid breaks cleanly at one, two and three columns. Keep every caveat that matters (edits are the least the model reads a trait; option order matters; every number replays from a committed record; trope questions test the model, not people); drop or fold anything a general reader does not need (e.g. the stand-in comparator note belongs in methods). No pre-registration talk, no build trivia.
